import sys
from collections import Counter


def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    if not data:
        return

    n = int(data[0])
    trees = data[1 : n + 1]

    counts = Counter(trees)
    ans = sum(v // 2 for v in counts.values())

    print(ans)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
